summary: Configured and verified a three-member MariaDB Galera cluster. All nodes are Primary, Synced, Ready, Connected, and share cluster size 3; cross-node writes replicated successfully.
actions_performed: Installed MariaDB Galera and configured persistent WSREP settings.
Enabled MariaDB and persistent exact-source firewall rules.
Hardened accounts, removed test/anonymous access, and stored generated credentials securely.
Verified services, packages, listeners, grants, and boot persistence configuration.
